connector.name: Apache Pinot MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Query and manage Apache Pinot through MCP with typed tools and preview-first safety.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-pinot-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the startreedata account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: PINOT_CONTROLLER_URL
env.description: HTTP(S) endpoint of the Pinot Controller.

env.name: PINOT_BROKER_URL
env.description: HTTP(S) endpoint of the Pinot Broker.

env.name: PINOT_TOKEN
env.description: Optional Pinot bearer token. Overrides username and password when set.

env.name: PINOT_USE_MSQE
env.description: Whether to enable Pinot multi-stage query engine support.

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default, for desktop clients) or 'http'.

env.name: AUTH_PROVIDER
env.description: Inbound auth provider for HTTP transport (e.g. 'oauth'); required to bind a non-loopback host.
